public void draw(java.awt.Graphics2D g,
                 java.lang.String code,
                 int angle,
                 MDCView view)
Description copied from interface: HieroglyphsDrawer
draws a hieroglyph, described by its code, on the drawing surface g. The view contains information about the scale, etc... TODO : add stuff about rotation ? or put it in the view ? Should be no-op if ! isKnown(code). IMPORTANT : also add stuff about reversal.

getShape

public java.awt.Shape getShape(java.lang.String code)
Description copied from interface: HieroglyphsDrawer
A try to test replacing bounding boxes by actual shapes. Should only be called if needed (rotations, complex sign placement). The shape needs not to be the real sign shape. It can be some sort of "bounding shape".
